title.zh: TV2V 与 RV2V：把源视频变成可训练的视频对
title.en: TV2V and RV2V: turning source clips into trainable video pairs

summary.zh: 两套视频推理数据集的工程做法：一条样本长什么样、为什么确定性别名是环境属性、闸门之间谁做什么，以及十六个走完正式审核的任务。
summary.en: How two video reasoning datasets were built: what a sample is, why determinism belongs to the environment, who owns each step between the gates, and the sixteen tasks that passed formal review.
